sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Please find 3 packages below. Each of them works for us; let us know which one suits you best.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We thank you for your prompt response and the options provided. As a family-run foundry with a long history together, we value our ongoing partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH deeply.

We are pleased to accommodate your request for a 24-month contract term, as outlined in your third package. In consideration of this longer commitment, we can revise our offer to €51.30 per unit while maintaining the 30-day payment terms.

To summarize our current offer clearly, we propose a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this proposal remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation and working together for the future.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We thank you for your revised offer and your willingness to find common ground. Based on your second package, we are prepared to lower our price to €50.10 per unit with 30-day payment terms. We are confident this step brings us very close to a final agreement that honors our long-standing partnership. 

For our complete Angebot, we are pleased to present a price of €50.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Over the years, our family foundry has always valued the deep trust and close cooperation between our companies. We proudly stand behind the craftsmanship of our people, and it is a true pleasure to work together toward a successful shared future.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
